design.distinctive_constraint: Never let an imperative recipe automatically transfer epistemic authority to a neighboring reported efficacy clause; a delayed result needs a named product/action link.

records.summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_UNSELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Creative extension grounded in one complete Lonitzer Dipsacus entry: the wine-cooked root becomes a stored medicine referred to as 'quod medicamentum', while 'eadem aqua' continues the distinct water resting on the leaves and assigns it another use. Hypothesis: a whole account that mentions multiple products must preserve separate local antecedents even when both belong to one plant entry. This exact co-tracking constraint is speculative and is not asserted by the source as a general rule; no target words are assigned.
